title: Energy Threat Analysis Center (ETAC) Intelligence Analyst Cyber - Lakewood, CO

The ETAC is a public\-private partnership that convenes experts from DOE and the United States (U.S.) energy sector to collectively identify, analyze, and mitigate cyber threats to America’s critical energy infrastructure. * Experience working with DOE National Laboratories
* Experience working within the IC
* Knowledge of electric grid infrastructure
* Knowledge of Advanced Persistent Threats (APTs) and state\-sponsored cyber adversaries
* Experience producing finished intelligence analysis for a variety of customer levels
* Experience delivering briefings to the Energy Sector technical personnel
* Knowledge of intelligence community analytic tradecraft, including structured analytic techniques
* Knowledge of the mission, structure, policies, and key intelligence programs of the U.S. intelligence community
* Ability to clearly and concisely articulate complex cyber topics to audiences with varying levels of expertise

title: Lead Substation Engineer - Physical
description:
Description:

Westwood Professional Services, Inc. is seeking a Lead Physical Engineer to join our Renewables Substation team. The primary functions of this role are to lead the substation Physical engineering and design efforts for large scale, transmission\-interconnected renewable energy projects and provide leadership and mentorship to a Physical design team consisting of three to five engineers and/or designers.


The Lead Physical Engineer will work with (and provide direction to) other engineers, designers, and drafters to develop project deliverables that satisfy all stakeholder requirements and comply with applicable codes \& standards. As part of the broader multi\-discipline Substation Team, the Lead Physical Engineer will work with the Substation Project Engineer and other discipline leads to ensure design documents are coordinated and consistent between the P\&C and Civil/Structural teams.

* Minimum of 7\-9 years of work experience in substation design and engineering
* Strong understanding of electrical systems and substation layouts, grounding, lightning protection, illumination and clearances
* PE License

* Excellent problem\-solving skills and attention to detail

title: Substation Drafter
description:
Description:

The Drafter will be a collaborative, detail\-oriented member of the Substation Engineering Group, responsible for preparing civil and electrical drawings in support of energy infrastructure projects. Working alongside engineers and consultants, this role contributes to the production of structural, foundation, and electrical drawings for power substation projects — including sections, plans, electrical one\-lines, and schematics — serving clients across Westwood's Power market portfolio.


This position is an excellent entry point for a motivated drafter who takes pride in accurate, high\-quality work and is eager to build foundational expertise in the power utility space within a team\-oriented consulting environment.

* Perform computer\-aided design and drafting of all engineering products and deliverables, including sections, plans, electrical one\-line diagrams, and schematics for substation projects.
* Support the preparation of structural, foundation, and electrical drawings for power substation infrastructure under the direction of engineering staff.
* Collaborate with engineers and fellow drafters to identify and correct discrepancies in drawings and designs.

* Manage multiple concurrent assignments, maintaining flexibility to accommodate changes in work scope or priorities as project needs evolve.
* Actively support full project delivery, including correspondence via phone or email, attendance at project meetings, and contribution to other project documentation as required.
* Provide interdepartmental support as needed to advance team and organizational goals.

* High school diploma or equivalent.

title: Contract Manager
description:
**Contract Manager**


*Legal, Risk \& Compliance — Client\-Embedded EPC Contracts \& Change Management*


**ABOUT ENERGY PROJECT PARTNERS**



Energy Project Partners (EPP) is a rapidly expanding energy project services firm providing project management, owner’s representation, field services, QA/QC, digital solutions, and technical consulting across a broad range of major capital and utility\-scale energy projects in the U.S. Through our integrated divisions — EPP Resources, EPP Field Services, and EPP Digital Solutions — we combine people, processes, and technology to deliver industry\-leading results.


**POSITION SUMMARY**



The Contract Manager is EPP’s engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) contracts subject\-matter expert, placed as an embedded resource within a client’s project organization. The role is the working conduit between the client’s legal department and its project execution department — translating legal intent into terms a project team can build to, and translating field and execution reality into language the legal team can stand behind.



The Contract Manager is engaged early, during pre\-construction, and stays with the contract through its full life. In pre\-construction, the role assembles the EPC request\-for\-proposal (RFP) package, organizes and controls the contract exhibits, and helps the pre\-construction project manager interpret and compare bid responses on a common basis. Through negotiation, the role owns the redline and revision process and advises on how specific terms shift risk, cost, and schedule exposure between the owner and the contractor. After the contract is executed, the role facilitates the change order and change management process so that scope, cost, schedule, and contractual entitlement stay aligned as the work proceeds.
